symbols.name: precision exponent
symbols.meaning: The exponent bounding the absolute value of each input coefficient by $2^p$.
symbols.quote: Let $p$ be a precision exponent such that every coefficient of the input polynomials has absolute value at most $2^p$.

symbols.name: block base
symbols.meaning: The base $B=2^{4p}$ in which packed integers are written, one block per coefficient.

symbols.name: packed polynomial
symbols.meaning: A polynomial in $\mathbb Z[y]$ of degree below $r$ whose coefficients have absolute value at most $2^p$; its packed integer is $u(B)$.
symbols.quote: For a polynomial $u=\sum_{j=0}^{r-1}u_j y^j$ in $\mathbb Z[y]$ with $|u_j|\le 2^p$, the packed integer is

symbols.name: coefficient of u
symbols.meaning: The $j$th coefficient of $u$, an integer of absolute value at most $2^p$.
symbols.quote: For a polynomial $u=\sum_{j=0}^{r-1}u_j y^j$ in $\mathbb Z[y]$ with $|u_j|\le 2^p$, the packed integer is

symbols.name: ordinary product
symbols.meaning: The ordinary product $uv$ in $\mathbb Z[y]$, before reduction modulo $y^r+1$.

symbols.name: product coefficient
symbols.meaning: The $j$th coefficient of the ordinary product $h=uv$.

relations.quote: Signed coefficient packing computes its integer products by the [Schönhage–Strassen to Harvey–van der Hoeven multiplication](ss-hh-background.md), an ordinary subroutine call that costs $O(n\log n)$.
